panels.description: Live switch telemetry. The throughput graph uses only the configured uplink RX and TX entities.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.domain == "sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.entity_id == "unifi_switch_uplink_rx" or
    r.entity_id == "unifi_switch_uplink_tx"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.domain == "sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.entity_id == "unifi_switch_cpu_utilisation" or
    r.entity_id == "unifi_switch_memory_utilisation" or
    r.entity_id == "unifi_switch_clients" or
    r.entity_id == "unifi_switch_uplink_speed"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id == "unifi_switch_state" and r._field == "state")
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.entity_id == "unifi_switch_firmware" and
    r._field == "installed_version_str"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["entity_id"])
  |> last()
